items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: but just like Pazio, Alfred Williams, and all them, they was playing during that time.

ctx.x: Remember who played there most of them?
No, I didn't know the fellas during them times, but some of them would still live now, but just like Pazio, Alfred Williams, and all them, they was playing during that time.
Who would you say would be your very favorite banjo if you had to pick one of all times? If you ever heard, if you don't mind, I don't want to put you on the spot because it's one of the good.
